resources.string: A checklist from a fresh install to a handheld that is ready to play: settings, games, emulators, saves
new device, new handheld, set up, setup, first start, getting started, checklist, wizard, restore, move, migrate, transfer
Six steps from a fresh install to a handheld that is ready to play. Each step opens the screen that does the work; nothing starts without your confirmation. Skip what you don\'t need.
Looking at what this handheld already has…
Every step is done, skipped or not needed.
Steps you skipped or marked as done yourself go back to what the app sees. Your settings, games and saves are not touched.
Bring your settings and sources over from your other handheld: restore a backup file, or use your own cloud (cloud backup or device sync).

resources.string: Your own cloud is connected, so your settings and sources can come from there.
Choose the folder that holds your games, or where new downloads should go.
No games found in the games folder yet. Put them there (or download them) and scan the folder again.
There are files in the games folder, but none in a console folder the app recognises. Library overview shows what was found.
Once there are games, this step shows which consoles still need an emulator.
The app knows no emulators for the consoles in your library. Pick an app per console yourself.
Every console with games has an emulator to start them.
Once sources or a backup are in, this step compares your favourites, collections and wishlist with what is on this handheld.
No favourites, collections, wishlist or RomM library to compare with. You can still copy games over from another device.
